SELECT
  CASE income_head::text
    WHEN 'business_sales' THEN 'Business / Enterprise Income'
    WHEN 'wage_income' THEN 'Worker / Wage Income'
    WHEN 'commission_income' THEN 'Commission Income'
    WHEN 'fixed_income' THEN 'Salary / Fees / Honorarium'

select
  productive_assets.id,
  productive_assets.tenant_id,
  productive_assets.woman_id,

  women.name as woman,
  women.phone,
  women.shg_name,
  women.district,
  women.partner_id,

  productive_assets.name,
  productive_assets.category,
  productive_assets.description,
  productive_assets.quantity,
  productive_assets.ownership,
  productive_assets.owner,
  productive_assets.acquired_on,
  productive_assets.purchase_cost,
  productive_assets.current_value,
  productive_assets.funding_source,
  productive_assets.condition,
  productive_assets.income_generating,
  productive_assets.monthly_income,
  productive_assets.status,
  productive_assets.evidence_url,
  productive_assets.notes,
  productive_assets.source,
  productive_assets.recorded_by,
  productive_assets.created_at,

  productive_assets.raw_transcript,
  productive_assets.source_message_id,
  productive_assets.extraction_confidence,
  productive_assets.review_flag,
  productive_assets.review_status,
  productive_assets.review_reason,
  productive_assets.reviewed_by,
  productive_assets.reviewed_at,

  case
    when productive_assets.purchase_cost > 0
      and productive_assets.current_value is not null
    then round(
      productive_assets.current_value
      / productive_assets.purchase_cost
      * 100,
      1
    )
    else null
  end as value_retained_percent

from productive_assets

join women
  on women.id = productive_assets.woman_id

where productive_assets.woman_id::text =
'{{components.c2281bfa-723b-466f-8096-29e9d5fd0dd2.selectedOption.value}}'

order by
  productive_assets.review_flag desc,
  productive_assets.created_at desc;

options.query:
SELECT name, phone, district, shg_name, nari_id,
       state, hub_code, nariscore, bank_ready, last_call_date
FROM (
    SELECT w.id, w.name, w.phone,
           w.district, w.shg_name, w.nari_id,
           w.state, w.hub_code,
           nr.nariscore, nr.bank_ready,
           max(le.entry_date) as last_call_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.id ORDER BY nr.nariscore DESC NULLS LAST) as rn
    FROM women w
    LEFT JOIN nariscore_records nr ON nr.phone = w.phone AND nr.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
    LEFT JOIN ledger_entries le ON le.woman_id = w.id
    WHERE w.tenant_id = 'janai'
    GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.phone, w.district, w.shg_name, w.nari_id,
             w.state, w.hub_code, nr.nariscore, nr.bank_ready
) sub
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY nariscore DESC NULLS LAST;
